Kit summary

Invincible MightBasicExclusive Lv.1
Deals 300% DEF DMG to a single enemy, with a 50% chance to reduce their DEF by 30% for 2 turns.
Guardian Staff Lv.1Invincible Might: Reduces DEF by 60% and increases the chance to 100%.
God's PunishmentActiveExclusive Lv.2
Removes [Shield] from the enemy target, and deals 600% DEF DMG. If the [Shield] is successfully removed, increases 30% DMG.
Guardian Staff Lv.2When God's Punishment successfully removes the [Shield], increases the DMG by 60%.
FuryPassive
Increases 30% DEF for all allies for 2 turns at the beginning of each wave. Schilder counterattacks with a basic attack and restores HP by 6% of self Max HP when he takes Direct DMG dealt by the target with a [Shield]. Can be stacked with the buff [Counterattack].
ExileActiveExclusive Lv.3
Increases self DEF by 30% for 2 turns. Afterwards, deals 260% DEF DMG to all enemies, with a 50% chance to inflict [Silence] for 1 turn. The chance doubles if the target has a [Shield].
Guardian Staff Lv.3Exile: Silences enemy targets with [Shield] first and removes the [Shield] from them, after which deals DMG.
